name: encryption removed
title: Remove bucket encryption
diff:
diff --git a/infra/s3.tf b/infra/s3.tf
--- a/infra/s3.tf
+++ b/infra/s3.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-      sse_algorithm = "aws:kms"

name: tls enforcement off
title: Turn off TLS enforcement
diff:
diff --git a/infra/db.tf b/infra/db.tf
--- a/infra/db.tf
+++ b/infra/db.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  ssl_enforcement_enabled = true
+  ssl_enforcement_enabled = false

name: auth disabled
title: Disable API auth
diff:
diff --git a/config/app.yaml b/config/app.yaml
--- a/config/app.yaml
+++ b/config/app.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  authentication_enabled: true
+  authentication_enabled: false

name: instance upsize
title: Upsize app server
diff:
diff --git a/infra/app.tf b/infra/app.tf
--- a/infra/app.tf
+++ b/infra/app.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  instance_type = "t3.medium"
+  instance_type = "m5.2xlarge"

name: memory limit cut
title: Lower memory limit
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/api.yaml b/k8s/api.yaml
--- a/k8s/api.yaml
+++ b/k8s/api.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-            memory: 512Mi
+            memory: 256Mi

name: base image bump
title: Upgrade python image
diff:
diff --git a/Dockerfile b/Dockerfile
--- a/Dockerfile
+++ b/Dockerfile
@@ -1 +1 @@
-FROM python:3.11-slim
+FROM python:3.12-slim

name: proxy timeout
title: Shorten proxy timeout

name: rename test
title: Rename test
diff:
diff --git a/tests/test_api.py b/tests/test_api.py
--- a/tests/test_api.py
+++ b/tests/test_api.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-def test_get():
+def test_get_returns_200():

name: error message typo
title: Fix typo in error
diff:
diff --git a/app/errors.py b/app/errors.py
--- a/app/errors.py
+++ b/app/errors.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-    raise ValueError("Invlaid input")
+    raise ValueError("Invalid input")

name: type hints
title: Add type hints
diff:
diff --git a/app/utils.py b/app/utils.py
--- a/app/utils.py
+++ b/app/utils.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-def parse(s):
+def parse(s: str) -> list[str]:
